title.en: Spotless yard waste removal and dog walking

text.en: Most clients praise the thorough pet waste cleanup and dog walking services, noting that yards are left clean and free of unpleasant odors. Pet owners appreciate returning home to spotless lawns and well-exercised pets. While one reviewer experienced inconsistent service during an owner transition period, the vast majority highlight reliable and thorough outdoor cleanup.

title.en: Friendly and patient pet care team

text.en: Reviewers frequently commend the handlers for their kindness, friendly attitude, and ethical approach to pet care. Clients note that team members are patient when answering questions and accommodating special requests for pets. Several customers mention that their dogs genuinely look forward to visits from the handlers, creating a trusted bond with families.

title.en: Mixed experiences with communication and response times

text.en: Customer feedback regarding customer support is mixed across the review period. Several clients report prompt responses, helpful answers to service inquiries, and polite interactions. However, two reviewers expressed significant frustration with unanswered telephone calls, delayed email replies, and confusing scheduling during company management changes.

q.en: What services does Magic Unicorn provide in Dallas?

a.en: The company provides residential pet waste removal, yard deodorizing, dog walking, and cat litter box care.

q.en: Are the dog walkers and pet waste technicians friendly with dogs?

a.en: Yes, multiple clients mention that handlers are friendly and that their dogs enjoy interacting with them.

q.en: How do clients report communication with the company?

a.en: Reviews are mixed; several clients report smooth service, while others experienced delays in email and phone replies.

q.en: Can pet owners arrange recurring yard waste pickups?

a.en: Yes, the company offers routine scheduled visits for dog waste scooping and yard maintenance.
